rendererTargets.contract: Render the neutral componentTree, apply visualContract style precedence, resolve design token references, connect bindings, and dispatch declared actions. Extensions are optional.

visualContract.gradientFallback: Use fallbackColor when a target cannot render the declared gradient.
instructions: Never replace a declared background, foreground, border, gradient, radius, shadow, spacing, or typography value with a platform default.
Apply designSystem.componentStyles for every node with styleRef, then deep-merge node.style over it.
Render viewport separately from the phone screen so the surrounding canvas does not use the host application default color.
Preserve per-parameter node.style colors and style.parts overrides.
Render declared decorations such as the HeroCard ring and ParameterCard left accent.
Use component part styles for titles, subtitles, badges, icons, accessories, switches, pager buttons, and status indicators.

html.styleResolution: CSS custom properties plus inline/class styles; implement structured gradients with CSS gradients and decorations with pseudo-elements.

flutter.styleResolution: BoxDecoration, LinearGradient/RadialGradient, BoxShadow, BorderRadius, Padding and Stack/Positioned decorations.

androidXml.styleResolution: Material shape appearances and drawable XML; use GradientDrawable/layer-list for structured fills and View overlays for decorations.

swiftUI.styleResolution: Shape fills, LinearGradient/RadialGradient, overlay, shadow, clipShape and ZStack decorations.

reactNative.styleResolution: StyleSheet plus a gradient component for structured fills; use absolute View overlays for decorations.

componentContract.Switch: Render with the controlCard template and switchAccessory. Do not render as a plain switch row.
componentContract.Slider: Render with the controlCard template and sliderAccessory. Use stacked layout with meta chip and range line.
componentContract.ActionCard: Render with the controlCard template and actionAccessory/meta chip. Do not render as a plain row with chevron.
componentContract.ParameterCard: Visual template used by both Switch and ActionCard: left round icon, label/value stack, and right accessory chip/toggle/dot.
componentContract.SlideHero: Must render the dark hero card with live control kicker and page count badge.
componentContract.PageSliderControls: Must render previous arrow, numbered page buttons, next arrow, and progress bar.

forbiddenSimplifications: Do not render controls as a standalone generic list.
Do not omit brandStrip, slideHero, nameCard, progress, or sliderControls.
Do not replace ActionCard meta chips with a plain chevron unless control.rightAccessory.type is explicitly none.
Do not ignore renderer.css or renderer.componentTemplates.

renderInstructions: Fetch device-ui v4 schema from the schema API.
Pass extensions.serverDrivenUi to SduiEngine — this is the production Flutter render document.
Bind all control values through state.parameters.<key>.value.
Open Wi-Fi from actions.openWifiConfig and render wifiProvisioning.screens. Bind native library methods from wifiProvisioning.libraries / nativeLibraries.wifi.
Header scan on wifiNetworkPicker opens wifiProvisioning.screens.qrScanner. App must call actions.openScanner / nativeLibraries.scan to open the camera QR page.
Never persist accessToken, routerPassword, or devicePop. dataSources.wifiConfig is post-provision status only.
After provisioning success, enable mqtt/deviceCommands and bind live control through state.parameters.
Use ui.widgetTree and controls[] only when STAC rendering is explicitly enabled.
